scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,whatsapp,ai -c blue,green,magenta,yellow "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w apps/whatsapp-worker" "npm run dev -w apps/ai-orchestrator"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/pedidos-core && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/whatsapp-worker && npm run build -w apps/ai-orchestrator
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w packages/pedidos-core && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w apps/whatsapp-worker && npm run typecheck -w apps/ai-orchestrator
